newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Hudson Conway holders approve issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Hudson Conway holders approve issue.

text.p: Hudson Conway Ltd shareholders on Thursday approved the company's issue of A$120 million in unsecured notes and the granting of options in an exclusive institutional offer.

The notes carry a nine percent coupon and mature on November 30, 2001. Each two notes will come with nine options, with an exercise price of A$22.50 and exercisable at six monthly intervals from July 1988.
The funds raised will be used to pursue major projects in Australia, to retire debt and for working capital, Hudson Conway chairman Sir Roderick Carnegie told a shareholders meeting.

Carnegie defended the board's decision not to include a shareholders' entitlement to the notes. "We thought we could get the issue done faster and with less dispersal of management effort," he said. -- Melbourne bureau 613-9286-1421
